e1.speaker: envoy_veil
e1.text: Little blade. The widow is filling your ears with fog. Shall I clear them?

e2.speaker: envoy_veil
e2.text: There is a boy in the alley who steals bread. The Master dislikes thieves. Make an example of him. It will please the Master.

choices.text: What happens to your face when the Master is done with you?

e_obey.speaker: envoy_veil
e_obey.text: Mm. Your light dims so prettily.

e_defy.speaker: envoy_veil
e_defy.text: All of them were children once. Even the Master. Even you.

spared.speaker: envoy_veil
spared.text: You spared the thief. You fetch lanterns for widows. The Master notes everything, little blade. Everything.

again.speaker: envoy_veil
again.text: The Lamplighter circles beyond the canal. His lamps are very bright. Put them out.

post.speaker: envoy_veil
post.text: The Lamplighter's lamp is out. Do you hear them, little blade? All the lost, knocking in the fog. It's music.
